Unbox with care: Your piece will arrive in our beautiful branded packaging, so take a moment to enjoy the unboxing experience.

Handle gently: While our jewellery is crafted from durable materials like sterling silver, stainless steel, and brass (all plated in 18k gold), it’s always good to avoid harsh chemicals, perfumes, or lotions to keep it looking its best.
